name: mcpscore
description: Audit the MCP server you're building with mcpscore: a deterministic score with a cited finding and a suggested fix for every rule it fails. Then fix your own server code and re-audit to prove it. Works on a server URL, a local server file or a stdio command.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and fix the MCP server you're building
defaultPrompt: Audit my MCP server with mcpscore.
